# LiveBridge tools reference

<!-- Generated by installers/gen_tools_doc.py — do not edit by hand. Regenerate with: .venv/bin/python installers/gen_tools_doc.py -->

**168 MCP tools** in 22 modules, backed by **200 bridge commands** in 23 namespaces (103 of them mutating = one undo step each).

Conventions shared by every tool (see `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` §5 and `remote_script/LiveBridge/resolve.py`):

- `track`: index into `song.tracks`, name (exact, case-insensitive, unique prefix, then a unique fuzzy match), return letter `"A"`, `"master"`, `"selected"` or a LOM path.
- `slot`: scene index or scene name. `clip`: LOM path (clip, clip slot or arrangement clip), clip name or `"selected"`. `device` / `parameter`: index, name or LOM path.
- Times: numbers are beats (quarter notes). Song positions, loop points and clip lengths also take `"17.1.1"` strings = bars.beats.sixteenths (1-based positions, 0-based lengths such as `"4.0.0"`); note times inside a clip are clip-relative beats.
- `detail`: `"minimal"` | `"summary"` | `"full"`. Paged results carry `total`, `offset`, `count` and `next_offset` (only when more follow).
- Errors are `{"error": "<one line>", "type": ..., "cmd": ...}`; types: `connection`, `auth`, `bad_args`, `not_found`, `invalid_state`, `unsupported`, `timeout`, `forbidden`, `internal`.

## MCP tools

<a id="module-analysis"></a>

### analysis

Analysis tools — Claude's ears and theory check: `live_theory_analyze` reads the notes of one or more MIDI clips and reports key, chords (with Roman numerals), out-of-key notes and clashes between parts; `live_audio_analyze` measures an audio file or audio clip (LUFS, peaks, spectral balance, stereo, tempo, key, energy over time) and can compare it with a reference track.

#### `live_theory_analyze`

Music-theory check of one or more MIDI clips: which key they are in, the chord progression (names + Roman numerals), notes outside the key, clashes between parts (semitone rubs, mud in the low register) and per-part statistics with suggestions. Read-only. Use it before adding a part to existing material ("what key is this?"), and after writing parts to verify that bass, chords and lead agree.

| Argument | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `track` | int \| str \| null | `null` |
| `slot` | int \| str \| null | `null` |
| `clip` | str \| null | `null` |
| `clips` | list[any] \| null | `null` |
| `key` | str \| null | `null` |
| `segment` | float \| null | `null` |
| `drums` | str | `"auto"` |

Bridge: `devices.list`, `notes.get`, `transport.get`

#### `live_audio_analyze`

Listen to audio by measuring it: loudness (LUFS, true peak, crest factor, loudness range, clipping), spectral balance in 8 bands with mix flags (mud, harshness, missing sub ...), stereo width and mono compatibility, tempo, key and the energy over time — of an audio file, an audio clip in the set (e.g. a `live_record_resample` bounce or a Splice loop), optionally compared with a reference track. Read-only.

| Argument | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `file_path` | str \| null | `null` |
| `track` | int \| str \| null | `null` |
| `slot` | int \| str \| null | `null` |
| `clip` | str \| null | `null` |
| `reference` | str \| null | `null` |
| `kind` | str | `"auto"` |
| `start` | float \| null | `null` |
| `duration` | float \| null | `null` |
| `sections` | bool | `true` |

Bridge: `clips.get`

#### `live_automation_record`

Record real ARRANGEMENT automation (track automation lanes) — tempo ramps, master filter sweeps, return-track sends, long builds. Live's API cannot draw lanes, so this does it like a person: Arrangement Record + Automation Arm on, playback from `preroll` beats before `start`, the parameter moved along your curve on every tick, stop at `end`, then loop / punch / Automation Arm / armed tracks / playhead are restored.

| Argument | Type | Default |

How to connect Splice to Claude and get Splice sounds into Live: the official Splice MCP URL, exact setup steps for Claude Desktop and Claude Code, Splice's MCP tool names, subscription limits, where to save downloads, and the recommended workflow.

| Argument | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `check_live` | bool | `true` |

Bridge: `browser.roots`, `samples.locations`

#### `live_splice_import_downloaded`

Import Splice downloads into Live: the exact files the Splice MCP reported (`files`), or the newest download(s) found on the Live machine.

| Argument | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `files` | list[str] \| null | `null` |
| `folder` | str \| null | `null` |
| `track` | int \| str \| null | `null` |
| `mode` | str | `"session"` |
| `newest` | int | `1` |
| `pattern` | str \| null | `null` |
| `slot` | int \| str \| null | `null` |
| `time` | float \| str \| null | `null` |
| `note` | int \| str \| null | `null` |
| `max_age_minutes` | float \| null | `null` |
| `warp` | bool \| null | `null` |
| `track_name` | str \| null | `null` |
| `upload` | bool \| null | `null` |

Bridge: `samples.import`, `samples.import_midi`, `samples.list`, `samples.locations`

#### `live_splice_watch_folder`

Wait for a new sample to land on the Live machine — a download you make BY HAND in the Splice desktop app or a web browser while this waits — then import it.

| Argument | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `seconds` | float | `45.0` |
| `folder` | str \| null | `null` |
| `track` | int \| str \| null | `null` |
| `mode` | str | `"session"` |
| `pattern` | str \| null | `null` |
| `import_file` | bool | `true` |
| `warp` | bool \| null | `null` |

Bridge: `samples.inspect`, `samples.list`

<a id="module-system"></a>

### system

System tools: connection status, connecting/switching, LAN discovery, command catalogue, log.

#### `live_status`

Check whether Ableton Live is reachable and report what it is. Call this first.

| Argument | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `refresh` | bool | `false` |
| `include_server` | bool | `false` |

Bridge: `system.hello`, `system.ping`, `system.status`

#### `live_connect`

Point LiveBridge at a (different) Ableton Live instance and verify it answers.

| Argument | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `host` | str | **required** |
| `port` | int | `9880` |
| `token` | str \| null | `null` |
| `persist` | bool | `false` |

Bridge: `system.hello`

#### `live_discover`

Find Ableton Live machines running LiveBridge on the local network (UDP beacons).

| Argument | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `seconds` | float | `3.0` |
| `port` | int | `9881` |

Bridge: none (runs in the MCP server)

#### `live_commands`

List the bridge commands this Live installation actually supports (the truth, live).

| Argument | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `namespace` | str \| null | `null` |
| `include_doc` | bool | `true` |

Bridge: `system.commands`

#### `live_command_call`

Run any LiveBridge bridge command by name — the escape hatch for the few commands that have no curated tool (e.g. `notes.theory`, `transport.continue`, `browser.cache`).

| Argument | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `cmd` | str | **required** |
| `args` | object \| null | `null` |
| `timeout` | float \| null | `null` |

Bridge: none (runs in the MCP server)

#### `live_log`

Write a line into Ableton Live's Log.txt (through the Remote Script), and/or read back what LiveBridge logged this session.

| Argument | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `message` | str \| null | `null` |
| `level` | str | `"info"` |
| `tail` | int | `0` |

Bridge: `system.log`

#### `live_command_batch`

Run several bridge commands in one round trip, in one main-thread pass, as ONE undo step (`system.batch`). The fast way to do multi-step builds such as an 8-bar beat (create tracks, load devices, write clips, set the mix) without one tool call per step.

| Argument | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `commands` | list[object] | **required** |
| `stop_on_error` | bool | `true` |
| `timeout` | float \| null | `null` |

Bridge: `system.batch`

#### `live_dialog_get`

Is a modal dialog (message box) open in Live, and what does it say? (`system.dialog`). Check it when commands suddenly fail or time out.

No arguments.

Bridge: `system.dialog`

#### `live_dialog_press`

Answer Live's current modal dialog by pressing one of its buttons (`system.dialog_press`). ALWAYS confirm with the user which button to press first.

| Argument | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `button` | int | **required** |
| `expect` | str \| null | `null` |

Bridge: `system.dialog_press`

## Bridge commands

Every command registered in the Remote Script (`system.commands` returns the same list at runtime). *M* = mutating (one undo step).

| Command | M | Parameters | MCP tool | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `arrangement.back_to_arranger` |  | track=null | `live_transport_set` (back_to_arranger=false) | Press 'Back to Arrangement': session clips stop overriding the timeline |
| `arrangement.copy_range` | M | start, end, destination, unit="beats", tracks=null, replace=true | `live_arrangement_copy_range` | Copy a time range of the arrangement (all or some tracks) to another position |
| `arrangement.create_audio_clip` | M | track, file_path, start=0.0, unit="beats", name=null, color_index=null | `live_arrangement_create_clip` | Place an audio file on the arrangement timeline |
| `arrangement.create_midi_clip` | M | track, start, length=null, unit="beats", name=null, color_index=null, looping=null | `live_arrangement_create_clip` | Create an empty MIDI clip on the arrangement timeline |
| `arrangement.delete_clip` | M | track=null, index=null, at=null, clip=null, unit="beats" | `live_arrangement_delete_clip` | Delete an arrangement clip |
| `arrangement.duplicate_clip` | M | time, track=null, slot=null, clip=null, target_track=null, unit="beats", length=null, count=null, replace=true | `live_arrangement_duplicate_clip` | Copy a session clip (or any clip) onto the arrangement timeline — once, repeated, or stretched to fill a length |
| `arrangement.from_scenes` | M | sections, start=null, unit="beats", tracks=null, replace=true | `live_arrangement_from_scenes` | Build a song: lay scenes out one after another on the timeline (one call for every track and section) |
| `arrangement.list` |  | track=null, start=null, end=null, unit="beats", detail="minimal", include_take_lanes=false, offset=0, limit=200 | `live_arrangement_clips` | List arrangement clips (start/end/name) per track |
| `arrangement.loop` | M | enabled=null, start=null, end=null, length=null, unit="beats" | `live_transport_set_loop` (same loop brace) | Read or set the arrangement loop region |
| `arrangement.move_clip` | M | start, track=null, index=null, at=null, clip=null, target_track=null, unit="beats" | `live_arrangement_move_clip` | Move an arrangement clip to a new time (and optionally another track) |
| `arrangement.overview` |  | start=null, end=null, unit="beats", grid=true, max_columns=64, include_empty=false | `live_arrangement_overview` | The whole arrangement at a glance: tracks x time, loop, cues, bar grid |
| `arrangement.position` |  | time=null, jump_by=null, unit="beats" | `live_transport_set_position` (read: live_transport_get) | Read, set or nudge the arrangement playhead |
| `arrangement.resize_clip` | M | track=null, index=null, at=null, clip=null, length=null, end=null, unit="beats" | `live_arrangement_resize_clip` | Change an arrangement clip's length on the timeline (a looped clip repeats its loop) |
| `automation.clear` | M | track=null, slot=null, clip=null, parameter=null, device=null, all=false, start=null, end=null | `live_automation_clear` | Clear one clip envelope (optionally a time range) or all envelopes of a clip |
| `automation.copy` | M | parameter, targets, track=null, slot=null, clip=null, device=null, shift=0.0, scale=1.0, target_parameter=null, clear=true | `live_automation_copy` | Copy one parameter's envelope from a clip to other clips (optional shift/scale) |
| `automation.get` |  | parameter, track=null, slot=null, clip=null, device=null, start=null, end=null, points=16, step=null, display=false, include_events=false | `live_automation_get` | Read one envelope of a clip, sampled at N points or a beat grid |
| `automation.list` |  | track=null, slot=null, clip=null, sample=0, include_available=false, filter=null, limit=200 | `live_automation_list` | Which parameters have envelopes in a clip (+ what could be automated) |
| `automation.overview` |  | track, include_empty=false | `live_automation_overview` | One-call automation overview of a track: envelopes per clip, automated parameters, re-enable state |
| `automation.re_enable` | M | track=null, parameter=null, device=null | `live_automation_state` | Re-enable overridden automation for a parameter, a track or the whole song |
| `automation.record` | M | parameter=null, track=null, device=null, points=null, shape=null, start=null, end=null, low=0.0, high=1.0, normalized=null, period=null, cycles=null, phase=0.0, duty=0.5, curve=1.0, seed=null, mode="linear", preroll=1.0, action="start" | `live_automation_record` | Record ARRANGEMENT track automation: play the song through a range while moving a parameter (Arrangement Record + Automation Arm) |
| `automation.record_status` |  |  | `live_automation_record` | Progress / result of the running or last automation.record pass |
| `automation.shape` | M | parameter, shape="sine", track=null, slot=null, clip=null, device=null, start=null, end=null, low=0.0, high=1.0, normalized=true, period=null, cycles=null, phase=0.0, step=null, duty=0.5, curve=1.0, seed=null, clear=false, mode="step", slots=null, extend_clip=false | `live_automation_shape` | Write a shape (ramp, sine/triangle/saw LFO, square, seeded random) into a clip envelope, or one continuous shape across several clips |
| `automation.state` |  | track=null, parameter=null, device=null, include_all=false | `live_automation_state` | Automation state (none/playing/overridden) of a parameter, a track or the whole set |
| `automation.write` | M | parameter, points, track=null, slot=null, clip=null, device=null, mode="step", resolution=16, end=null, normalized=false, clear=false, extend_clip=false | `live_automation_write` | Write a clip envelope from points [{time, value}] as steps or linear ramps |
| `browser.browse` |  | path=null, uri=null, name=null, offset=0, limit=100, filter=null, kind=null, detail="summary" | `live_browser_browse` | List a browser folder's children by path, uri or name (paged) |
| `browser.cache` |  | action="info" | `live_browser_search` (refresh=true) | Browser search cache: info or clear |
| `browser.hotswap` |  | action="info", track=null, device=null, drum_pad=null | `live_browser_hotswap` | Hot-swap target: info, set (device / drum pad) or clear |
| `browser.load` | M | uri=null, path=null, query=null, root=null, category=null, track=null, slot=null, new_track=null, track_name=null, position="end", hotswap=false, device=null, drum_pad=null, plugin_format=null, max_seconds=10.0 | `live_browser_hotswap`, `live_browser_load` | Load a browser item (by uri, path or search) onto a track; reports what changed |
| `browser.preview` |  | uri=null, path=null, query=null, root=null, category=null, stop=false | `live_browser_preview` | Preview (audition) a browser item, or stop the preview |
| `browser.roots` |  | counts=true | `live_browser_roots`, `live_splice_setup_info` | Browser roots with item counts, extra roots, Splice and hot-swap info |
| `browser.search` |  | query, root=null, category=null, limit=20, offset=0, loadable_only=false, plugin_format=null, max_depth=12, max_visits=40000, max_seconds=10.0, refresh=false, detail="summary" | `live_browser_search` | Search the browser (cached bounded walk) by words, root, category |
| `clips.convert` | M | to, track=null, slot=null, clip=null, type="drums" | `live_clip_convert` | Live's audio conversions: audio clip -> MIDI (drums/melody/harmony), new Drum Rack track, new Simpler track |
| `clips.create` | M | track, slot=null, length=4.0, unit="beats", name=null, color_index=null, looping=null, file_path=null | `live_clip_create` | Create a MIDI clip (or an audio clip from a file) in a session slot |
| `clips.crop` | M | track=null, slot=null, clip=null | `live_clip_edit` | Crop a clip to its loop (or markers) |
| `clips.delete` | M | track=null, slot=null, clip=null | `live_clip_delete` | Delete a session or arrangement clip |
| `clips.duplicate` | M | track, slot, target_track=null, target_slot=null, overwrite=false | `live_clip_duplicate` | Duplicate a session clip to the next free slot or to a given slot |
| `clips.duplicate_loop` | M | track=null, slot=null, clip=null | `live_clip_edit` | Double the loop, duplicating its notes/envelopes |
| `clips.fire` |  | track=null, slot=null, clip=null, force_legato=false, launch_quantization=null | `live_clip_fire` | Launch a session clip slot (or a clip) |
| `clips.get` |  | track=null, slot=null, clip=null, detail="full", include_warp_markers=false | `live_audio_analyze`, `live_clip_get` | Everything about one clip (loop, markers, launch, audio props) |
| `clips.grooves` | M | groove=null, timing=null, random=null, velocity=null, quantize=null, base=null, name=null, include_clips=false | `live_groove_pool` | The set's Groove Pool: list grooves, change a groove's amounts/base, see which clips use them |
| `clips.list` |  | track=null, detail="minimal", include_arrangement=false, playing_only=false, offset=0, limit=200 | `live_clip_list` | List non-empty clips (session, optionally arrangement) of a track or the whole set |
